action.sql: SELECT g.period, SUM(g.debit - g.credit) AS software_subscriptions_spend FROM gl_lines g JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = g.account_id WHERE g.entity_id = 'CA01' AND a.type = 'Expense' AND a.account_id = '6200' AND g.period BETWEEN '2026-01' AND '2026-06' GROUP BY g.period ORDER BY g.period
